title: The freeze checker measures the current directory, not the worktree its freeze describes
outcome: A freeze check answers about the tree the freeze was taken from, or refuses; it never silently fingerprints a different tree and reports drift, because the review protocol treats that answer as authority to discard a completed review and restart from the gates
acceptance: A check run from a different worktree or repository refuses with a message naming both roots, instead of comparing fingerprints across trees and reporting drift
Regression: a freeze captured in a linked worktree and checked from the main worktree refuses; checked from its own worktree it verifies clean
The written freeze records the repository root or worktree identity it was captured from

completion.summary: Freeze checks bind the canonical Git worktree root, refuse foreign roots before content capture, and preserve whole-worktree scope from nested paths. Regressions and nine gates pass; Codex and Claude review accepted with the stream-observation recovery explicitly attributed.
